concept_summary: An adult lunar-tide ecologist activates a living wetland observatory by pouring luminous algae into a crescent bioreactor beneath a visible crescent moon.

reference.evaluation_note: Judge only visible appearance cues suitable for ordinary visual comparison; do not infer, verify, or score whether the rendered person is the same real individual.

review_protocol.target_gate_policy: Every target gate is hard; partial satisfaction counts as failure.
review_protocol.overall_pass_condition: All five target gates, both confound-rejection gates, and all three common photo/reference gates pass from visible pixels alone.

target_gates.observable_gate: The night sky contains one clearly recognizable large crescent moon, while a separate readable moon-phase motif or gauge is visible on the station or clothing.
target_gates.pass_condition: Both the celestial crescent and a distinct human-made lunar-cycle marker are plainly visible.
target_gates.fail_condition: Either element is absent, ambiguous, hidden, or only implied by color; partial counts as fail.

target_gates.observable_gate: A thriving wetland of reeds and lily pools is physically integrated into the working station through visible living vine or mycelium conduits.
target_gates.pass_condition: Wetland plants, water, and at least one organic conduit visibly form parts of one functional ecological system.
target_gates.fail_condition: Plants are merely potted decoration, the habitat looks dead, or the ecology and apparatus are visually disconnected; partial counts as fail.

target_gates.observable_gate: The adult woman is visibly pouring luminous blue-green algae from a glass vessel into a crescent-shaped translucent bioreactor, and connected pearlescent conduits visibly glow as the consequence.
target_gates.pass_condition: Actor, held source vessel, visible transfer, crescent reactor, and illuminated connected network are all legible in the same frame.
target_gates.fail_condition: Any link in the action-and-consequence chain is missing, unclear, or merely adjacent; partial counts as fail.

target_gates.observable_gate: Cool moonlight and blue-green or pearlescent biological light from algae, fungi, or mycelium illuminate the subject and reflect in the dark marsh water.
target_gates.pass_condition: At least two clearly organic light sources are visible and their cool reflections or light falloff affect the surrounding water or materials.
target_gates.fail_condition: The scene relies only on ordinary electric lamps, generic colored neon, or daylight; partial counts as fail.

target_gates.observable_gate: The observatory visibly combines handblown glass, moss-covered ceramic instruments, silver dew collectors, and living vine piping into credible working equipment.
target_gates.pass_condition: At least three named material or device families are recognizable, including one living component, and their placement suggests practical use.
target_gates.fail_condition: Fewer than three are visible, they read as loose fantasy ornaments, or no living component participates in the machinery; partial counts as fail.

confound_rejection_gates.observable_gate: Reject a daylight eco-utopia substitution: direct sun, a bright daytime sky, or conventional solar-panel arrays must not dominate the rendered scene over the visible moon and biological night lighting.
confound_rejection_gates.pass_condition: The image is unambiguously nocturnal and moon-led, with biological light central to the working ecology.
confound_rejection_gates.fail_condition: Daylight, sun imagery, or solar panels become the dominant energy-and-style signal.

confound_rejection_gates.observable_gate: Reject generic neon cyberpunk or ungrounded moon fantasy: dense city signage, chrome machinery, holographic clutter, or magical glow must not replace the visibly functional wetland-biotechnology relationship.
confound_rejection_gates.pass_condition: The advanced qualities remain materially tied to living marsh organisms, ecological work, and handcrafted apparatus.
confound_rejection_gates.fail_condition: Urban neon spectacle or unexplained magic dominates while functional ecology is absent or incidental.

common_photo_reference_gates.observable_gate: The main subject is unmistakably adult and visibly carries the reference portrait's long, voluminous, wavy near-black hair, dark eyes, softly oval face, and natural facial proportions.
common_photo_reference_gates.pass_condition: The face and hair are sufficiently unobscured to compare these ordinary visible appearance cues.
common_photo_reference_gates.fail_condition: The subject appears underage, the face is unreadable, or the major visible appearance cues diverge substantially. Biometric identity is never evaluated.

common_photo_reference_gates.observable_gate: The adult subject has coherent anatomy and plausible hand contact with the glass vessel while the pour direction, liquid path, and receiving bioreactor align physically.
common_photo_reference_gates.pass_condition: Hands, fingers, vessel, stream, and receiver form one plausible continuous action without duplicated or fused anatomy.
common_photo_reference_gates.fail_condition: Anatomy is malformed or the physical action cannot be followed from visible pixels.

common_photo_reference_gates.observable_gate: The image reads as a coherent photograph with natural skin detail, consistent light interaction, distinguishable glass, ceramic, plant, water, and fabric textures, and no intrusive generated text or watermark.
common_photo_reference_gates.pass_condition: The main subject, ecological action, and key materials remain clearly legible at normal viewing size.
common_photo_reference_gates.fail_condition: Severe blur, contradictory illumination, painterly collapse, illegible key objects, or intrusive text prevents reliable pixel judgment.
